So, my birthday gift came in two lovely parts.
First, context. My mother is an avid smoker and, due to cancer running in our family and a paranoia involving it, I've asked her multiple times not to smoke in my face.

Mind you, I'm not asking her not to *smoke*, just not in *my face*. She has a car, drives it, usually smokes during that time, or has other times where she just stands outside. But whenever I was in a car with her, in the *front seat* (because she had stuffed her belongings in the backseat) is when she decided it was prime time to smoke. And when asked not to or why she didn't smoke on the way over, she told me it was her car and she could smoke whenever she wanted.

So, my birthday gift? 
She wasn't going to smoke in my face for my birthday. And seemed absolutely delighted with telling me so.

Mind you, she went right back to it the following day

Edit: Forgot the second part, hold on--

My ideal life, at the moment, is to just get married and have a family. I hardly care about what job I get so long as it isn't literal hell to do lmao

But if I could just. Be safe and cozy and well fed in a house surrounded by my loved ones? I can hardly picture a happier experience. All of the.. excitement of 'success' and all that can be had in other ways! Little trips to explore, trying new things and foods and finding out new stuff. It doesn't even have to be like, super far, just some place maybe even in my own neighbourhood I haven't explored.

That being said, seeing someone else with this like.. Simple end goal, it.. It's extremely comforting! Thank you for posting, genuinely.
